create_FunctionalAdamW: create a _FunctionalAdamW optimizer instance with parameters, learning rate, betas, and weight decay settings
build_step_param: build a single parameter step by passing a tensor and its gradient to step_param for AdamW update
test_step_batch: test the step method by passing a list of gradients matching parameter count for batch AdamW update
refactor_amsgrad: refactor _FunctionalAdamW to enable amsgrad mode for maintaining max of exponential moving averages of squared gradients
review_fused_optimization: review the fused and foreach optimization flags in _FunctionalAdamW for performance-optimized AdamW computation
